answer: Make every new agent pay for its identity with a proof-of-work puzzle. The puzzle takes 20 minutes on a $300 GPU and costs $0.40 in electricity. The solved proof is pinned to the identity record, one puzzle per agent. A wallet that registers a second identity waits 24 hours before it activates. Forging 1,000 fakes then burns $400 in power and 333 GPU-hours, so one attacker needs 14 days on one GPU or 1,000 GPUs at once, while an honest agent pays 40 cents once. Like a garden where each plant carries its own cipher, the terrace admits only agents who did the work.
